background: QIB (UK) is the London subsidiary of Qatar Islamic Bank, the largest Islamic bank in Qatar, offering Sharia-compliant property finance and private banking to Gulf clients in Britain, funded by deposits and the parent.
synthesis: None of the three main agencies rates the bank, so the filings are the only evidence, and support from the Qatari parent is not something the figures show. Capital is sound, with CET1 of 17.9% and leverage of 10.7% at the median for UK small banks. LCR of 346% is at the median but has fallen 338 points since 31 Dec 2019, and NSFR of 128% is in the bottom quarter, the weak spot. The figures run only to 31 Dec 2025.
